spans.s: निर् ind. A substitute for निस् (q.v.) before vowels and soft consonants.
निर्-अंश a. 1. whole, entire; 2. not entitled to any share of the patrimony.
निर्-अक्ष m. the place of no latitude (in astronomy).
निर्-अग्नि a. having lost or neglected the consecrated fire.
निर्-अंकुश a. uncontrolled, unruly, unchecked, independent, कुवलयदृश वामः कामो निकामनिरंकुशः Git.G.vii. or निरंकुशाः कवयः.
निर्-अंग a. 1. having no parts; 2. deprived of expedients.
निर्-अजिन a. skinless.
निर्-अंजन (I) a. 1. without collyrium; 2. free from falsehood; 3. simple, artless.
निर्-अंजन (II) m. an epithet of Śiva.
निर्-अतिशय a. unsurpassed.
निर्-अत्यय a. 1. free from danger, secure, R.xvii.53; 2. free from fault, disinterested, Kir.i.12; 3. completely successful.
निर्-अध्व a. one who has lost his way.
निर्-अनुक्रोश (I) a. pitiless, hard-hearted.
निर्-अनुक्रोश (II) m. hard-heartedness.
निर्-अनुग a. without followers.
निर्-अनुनासिक a. not nasal.
निर्-अनुरोध a. 1. unfavourable, unfriendly; 2. unkind, unamiable.

निर्-अंतर a. 1. constant, perpetual, निरंतरास्वंतरवातवृष्टिषु K.S.v.25; 2. having no intervening space, having no interval, close, हृदयं निरंतरबृहत्कठिनस्तनमंडलावरणमप्यभिदन् Sis.ix.66; 3. compact, dense; 4. faithful, true (as a friend); 5. not hidden from view.
निर्-अंतरम् ind. 1. without interruption, constantly, continually; 2. closely, tightly, firmly, परिष्वंजते शयने निरंतरम् Rt.ii.11; 3. immediately.
निर्-अंतरम्˚अभ्यास m. constant study, diligent exrcise.
निर्-अंतराल a. without an intervening space, close.

निर्-अन्वय a. 1. having no issue, childless; 2. unconnected, unrelated; 3. not agreeing with the context (as a word); 4. without being seen, out of sight, M.viii.332; 5. without retinue, unattended, का स्वमेकाकिनी भीरु निरन्वयजने वने Bt.v.66.
निर्-अपत्रप a. 1. shameless, impudent; 2. bold.
निर्-अपराध a. innocent, faultless, blameless.
निर्-अपाय a. 1. free from decay, imperishable; 2. infallible.

निर्-अपेक्ष a. 1. having no necessity of, not depending on, (with a loc.), न्यायनिर्णीतसारत्वान्निरपेक्षमिवागमे Kir.xi.39; 2. without desire, indifferent, especially indifferent to worldly pursuits, M.vi.41; 3. not expecting anything from another; 4. without purpose.
निर्-अभिभव a. not subject to humiliation.
निर्-अभिमान a. free from self-conceit, devoid of egotism.
निर्-अभिलाष a. not intent upon, indifferent to, स्वसुखनिरभिलाषः ख्हिद्यसे लोकहेतोः Sak.v.
निर्-अभ्र a. cloudless.
निर्-अंबु a. 1. abstaining from water; 2. destitute of water.
निर्-अर्गल a. unbarred, unobstructed, unimpeded.
निर्-अर्थ a. 1. poor, indigent; 2. meaningless (as a word or sentence); 3. nonsensical, vain, purposeless.
निर्-अर्थक (I) a. 1. useless, vain, unprofitable; 2. unmeaning, nonsensical.
निर्-अर्थक (II) n. an expletive, निरर्थकं तुहीत्यादि पूरणैकप्रयोजनम् Chandrāloka.
निर्-अवकाश a. 1. without space; 2. without desire.
निर्-अवग्रह a. 1. unrestrained, unchecked, uncontrolled; 2. free, independent; 3. head-strong.
निर्-अवद्य a. blameless, faultless, unexceptionable, निरवद्यानि पद्यानि यदि नाट्यस्य का क्षतिः Bhavabhūti, as quoted in Sr.P.
निर्-अवधि a. unlimited.
निर्-अवयव a. 1. without parts; 2. without limbs.
निर्-अवलंब a. unsupported, without support.
निर्-अवशेष a. whole, complete.
निर्-अवशेषेण ind. completely, fully, totally.
निर्-अशन (I) a. abstaining from food.
निर्-अशन (II) n. fasting.
नीरसन a. having no girdle, Kir.v.11.
निरसन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Expelling, ejecting; 2. vomiting.
निरसन (II) n. 1. Ejecting, expulsion, removal; 2. denial, contradiction, refusal; 3. vomiting forth, spitting out; 4. checking, suppressing; 5. destruction, extirpation.
निर्-अस्त्र a. weaponless, unarmed.
निर्-अस्थि a. boneless.
निर्-अहंकार, -अहंकृति a. free from egotism, humble, lowly.
निर्-अहंकार, -अहंकृति a. free from egotism, humble, lowly.
निर्-अहम् a. free from self-conceit.
निर्-आकांक्ष a. 1. free from desire; 2. wanting nothing to make complete (as the sense of a sentence).
निर्-आकार (I) a. 1. formless, without form; 2. deformed; 3. disguised; 4. modest.
निर्-आकार (II) m. 1. the universal spirit; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. of Viṣṇu.
निर्-आकृति m. a Brāhmaṇa who has not pursued his studies.
निराकृति f. 1. Repudiation, rejection; 2. refusal; 3. obstruction, obstacle, interruption, opposition.
निर्-आक्रोश a. unaccused, unreviled.
निर्-आगस् a. faultless, innocent, R.viii.48.
निर्-आचार a. without customs or usage, lawless.
निर्-आडंबर a. without drums.
निर्-आतंक a. 1. free from fear; 2. without ailment, healthy.
निर्-आतप a. shady, not penetrated by the sun’s rays.
निर्-आतपा f. the night.
निर्-आदर a. disrespectful.
निर्-आधान a. without a receptacle.
निर्-आधार a. without support, supportless.
निर्-आधि a. free from anxiety.
नीर-धि, -निधि m. the ocean.
निर्-आपद् a. free from misfortune.

निर्-आबाध a. 1. secure from disturbance, unvexed; 2. unobstructed; 3. frivolously vexatious (as a suit); (the Mitākshara gives the following instance of a vexatious complaint- अस्मद्गृहप्रदीपप्रकाशेनायं स्वगृहे व्य्वहरति).
निर्-आमय (I) a. 1. free from illness, healthy; 2. free from defects; 3. infallible.
निर्-आमय (II) m.n. freedom from illness, health.
निर्-आमय (III) m. 1. a wild goat; 2. a hog.
निर्-आमिष a. 1. free from covetousness; 2. fleshless; 3. not receiving wages.
निर्-आय a. having no income or revenue.
निरय m. Hell, निरयनगरद्वारमुद्घाटयंति Bhartr.i.63, M.vi.61.
निर्-आयुध a. weaponless, unarmed.
निर्-आलंब a. 1. having no support; 2. friendless, alone, निरालंबो लंबोदरजननि कं यामि शरणम् Jag.
निर्-आलोक a. 1. deprived of light, dark; 2. deprived of sight.
निर्-आश a. hopeless, despairing of, मनो बभूवेंदुमतीनिराशम् R.vi.2, Rt.ii.12.
नीरस (I) a. 1. without juice, sapless, withered, श्लाघ्यं नीरसकाष्ठताडनशतम् Sr.

; 2. flavourless, unsavoury; 3. without charm, flat, insipid, ननु तर्हि प्रबंधांतर्वर्तिनां केषामपि नीरसानां पद्यानां काव्यत्वं न स्यादिति चेन्न S.D.i.; 4. vain, useless, fruitless, अलब्धफलनीरसान् (मनोरथान्) Vikr.ii.
नीरस (II) m. the pomegranate.
निरस (I) a. (f. सा) Tasteless, insipid, dry.
निरस (II) m. 1. Want of flavour, insipidity; 2. want of juice, dryness; 3. want of passion or feeling.
निरस (I) a. (f. सा) Tasteless, insipid, dry.
निरास m. 1. Ejection, expulsion, removal; 2. vomiting; 3. refutation.
निर्-आशंक a. fearless.
निर्-आशिस् a. 1. having no wishes or hopes, indifferent, K.S.v.76; 2. without a blessing.
निर्-आश्रय a. 1. helpless, friendless, निराश्रयं मां जगदीश रक्ष Ud.; 2. without a proper support.
निर्-आस्वाद a. tasteless, unsavoury.
निर्-आहार (I) a. foodless, abstaining from food.
निर्-आहार (II) m. fasting.
निर्-इच्छ a. without wish or desire, indifferent.
निर्-इंद्रिय a. 1. having lost a limb; 2. mutilated, maimed, M.ix.18.
निर्-इंधन a. destitute of fuel.
निर्-ईति a. free from the calamities of the season, R.i.63.
निर्-ईश्वर a. atheistic.
निर्-ईष n. the body of a plough.
निरीश(ष) n. A plough-share.
निरीश(ष) n. A plough-share.
निर्-ईह a. desireless, indifferent, R.x.24.
निर्-उच्छ्वास (I) a. breathless, without breathing.
निर्-उच्छ्वास (II) m. absence of breath.
निर्-उत्तर a. 1. answerless, without a reply; 2. unable to answer, silenced.
निर्-उत्सव a. without festivities, विरतं गेयमृतुर्निरुत्सवः R.viii.66.
निर्-उत्साह a. without energy, indolent.
निर्-उदक a. waterless.
निर्-उद्यम, -उद्योग a. effortless, lazy, idle.
निर्-उद्यम, -उद्योग a. effortless, lazy, idle.
निर्-उद्वेग a. free from perturbation, sedate, calm.
निर्-उपक्रम a. without a commencement.
निर्-उपद्रव a. 1. free from calamity or affliction, undisturbed, unmolested, free from hostile attacks; 2. free from national distress; 3. causing no affliction.
निर्-उपधि a. guileless, honest.
निर्-उपपत्ति a. unsuitable.
निर्-उपपद a. 1. without any title; 2. unconnected with a subordinate word.
निर्-उपप्लव a. free from disturbance, unharmed, निरुपप्लवानि नः कर्माणि संवृत्तानि Sak.iii.
निर्-उपम a. peerless, matchless, incomparable.
निर्-उपसर्ग a. free from portents.
निर्-उपाख्य a. 1. unreal, false, nonexistent, (e.g. वंध्यापुत्र); 2. invisible.
निर्-उपाय a. without expedients, helpless.
निर्-उपेक्ष a. free from trick or fraud.
निर्-उष्मन् a. devoid of heat, cold.
निर्-गंध a. scentless, unfragrant, inodourous, e.g. निर्गंधा इव किंशुकाः.
निर्-गंध˚पुष्टि f. the śālmalī tree.
निर्-गर्व a. free from pride.
निर्-गवाक्ष a. windowless.
निर्-गुण (I) a. 1. stringless; 2. devoid of all properties; 3. devoid of good qualities, bad, worthless, निर्गुणः शोभते नैव विपुलाडंबरोऽपि ना Bh.V.i.115.
निर्-गुण (II) m. the supreme spirit.
निर्-गृह a. houseless, homeless.
निर्-गौरव a. without dignity, undignified.
निर्-ग्रंथ (I) a. 1. free from all hindrances; 2. poor, possessionless; 3. alone, unassisted.
निर्-ग्रंथ (II) m. 1. an idiot, a fool; 2. a gambler, a gamester; 3. a devotee who has withdrawn from the world and wanders about naked.
निर्-ग्रंथिक (I) a. clever.
निर्-ग्रंथिक (II) m. a naked mendicant, a Jaina mendicant of the Digambara order.
निर्-घट n. 1. a free market; 2. a crowded market.
निर्-घृण a. 1. unmerciful, pitilass; 2. shameless, immodest.
निर्-जन (I) a. uninhabited, unfrequented, desolate.
निर्-जन (II) n. a desert, a lonely place.
निर्-जर (I) a. 1. young, fresh; 2. imperishable.
निर्-जर (II) m. a deity, a god; (nom. pl. निर्जराः, निर्जरसः).
निर्-जर (III) n. nectar.
निर्-जल (I) a. 1. destitute of water; 2. not mixed with water.
निर्-जल (II) m. a desert.
निर्-जिह्व m. a frog.
निर्-जीव a. lifeless, dead.
निर्-ज्वर a. feverless, healthy.
निर्-दंड m. a Śūdra.
निर्-दय a. 1. unmerciful, unkind, cruel; 2. excessive, violent, too close, निर्दयाश्लेषहेतोः Megh.ii.43, मुग्धे विधेहि मयि निर्दयदंतदंशम् Git.G.x., R.xix.32.
निर्-दयम् ind. 1. unmercifully; 2. violently, excessively, R.xi.84.
निर्-दश a. more than ten days old.
निर्-दशन a. toothless.
निर्-दुःख a. free from pain.
निर्-दोष a. 1. faultless, defectless; 2. guiltless, innocent.
निर्-द्रव्य a. without property, poor.
निर्-द्रोह a. not hostile, friendly.

निर्-द्वंद्व a. 1. indifferent in regard to opposite pairs of feelings, निर्द्वंद्वो नित्यसत्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान् Bg.ii.45; 2. not dependant upon another; 3. free from jealousy; 4. not acknowledging two principles.
निर्-धन (I) a. poor, indigent, e.g. शशिनस्तुल्यवंशोऽपि निर्धनः परिभूयते Cāṇakya.
निर्-धन (II) m. an old ox.
निर्-धर्म a. unrighteous, impious.
निर्-धूम a. smokeless.
निर्-नर a. abandoned by men.
निर्-नाथ a. without a guardian or master.
निर्-निद्र a. sleepless.
निर्-निमित्त a. causeless.
निर्-निमेष a. not twinkling.
निर्-बंधु a. without kindred, friendless.
निर्-बल a. powerless, weak, feeble.
निर्-बाध a. 1. unobstructed; 2. unfrequented, lonely; 3. unmolested.
निर्-बुद्धि a. ignorant, foolish.
निर्-बुष, -बुस a. unhusked, freed from chaff.
निर्-बुष, -बुस a. unhusked, freed from chaff.
निर्-भय a. 1. fearless, undaunted; 2. free from danger, secure, M.ix.255.
निर्-भर (I) a. 1. excessive, exceeding, violent, Am.
; 2. ardent; 3. fast, close, त्वत्कुचकुंभनिर्भरपरीरंभामृतं वांछति Git.G.v.; 4. (at the end of a compound) full of, filled with.
निर्-भर (II) n. excess.
निर्-भरम् ind. excessively, exceedingly.
निर्-भाग्य a. unfortunate, unlucky.
निर्-भृति a. without wages.
निर्-मक्षिक a. free from flies, i.e. private, lonely.
निर्-मक्षिकम् ind. without flies, i.e. lonely, private, कृतं भवतेदानीं निर्मक्षिकम् Sak.ii., vi.
निर्-मत्सर a. free from envy, unenvious.
निर्-मत्स्य a. fishless.
निर्-मद a. 1. sober, quiet; 2. not proud, humble; 3. not in rut (as an elephant).
निर्-मनुज, -मनुष्य a. uninhabited, deserted by men.
निर्-मनुज, -मनुष्य a. uninhabited, deserted by men.
निर्-मन्यु a. free from anger.

निर्-मम a. 1. disinterested; 2. free from all connection with the outer world, निर्ममो निरहंकारः Bg.ii.71, R.xii.60; 3. indifferent to, (with a loc.), निर्ममे निर्ममोऽर्थेषु मथुरां मधुराकृतिः R.xv.28.
निर्-मर्याद a. 1. boundless, immeasurable; 2. unruly, sinful, criminal, मनुजपशुभिर्निर्मर्यादैर्भवद्भिरुदायुधैः Ve.iii.
निर्-मल (I) a. 1. free from impurities, clear, pure; 2. splendent, bright, Bhartr.i.56; 3. sinless, virtuous, M.M.viii.318.
निर्-मल (II) n. 1. talc; 2. the remains of an offering made to a deity.
निर्-मल˚उपल m. crystal.
निर्-मशक a. free from gnats.
निर्-मांस a. fleshless.
निर्-मानुष a. uninhabited, desolate.
निर्-मार्ग a. roadless, pathless.
निर्-मुट (I) m. 1. the sun; 2. a rogue.
निर्-मुट (II) n. a free market or fair.
निर्-मूल a. 1. rootless (as a tree); 2. baseless, unfounded; 3. eradicated.
निर्-मेघ a. cloudless.
निर्-मेध a. without understanding, stupid, dull.
निर्-मोह a. free from illusion.
निर्-यत्न a. inactive, lazy.
निर्-यंत्रण (I) a. unrestrained, unobstructed, uncontrolled, independant.
निर्-यंत्रण (II) n. absence of restraint, independence.
निर्-यशस्क a. without fame, inglorious.
निर्-यूथ a. separated from the herd, strayed from the flock.
नीरक्त a. colourless, faded.
नीरज a. 1. free from dost; 2. devoid of passion.
नीर-ज n. 1. lotus; 2. a pearl.
नीरज a. 1. free from dost; 2. devoid of passion.
नीरजस् (I) a. See नीरज.
नीरजस् (II) f. a woman not menstruating.
नीरजस्˚तमसा f. absence of passion and darkness.
नीरंध्र a. 1. without holes, close; 2. coarse, thick.
नीरव a. not making any sound, noiseless, R.viii.58.
नीरुच् a. lustreless, dim, faded.
नीरुज् a. free from sickness, healthy, e.g. नीरुजस्य किमौषधैः.
नीरुज् a. free from sickness, healthy, e.g. नीरुजस्य किमौषधैः.
नीरूप a. formless, shapeless.
नीरोग a. free from sickness, healthy.
निर्-लक्षण a. 1. having no auspicious marks; 2. unimportant, insignificant.
निर्-लज्ज a. shameless, impudent, Sr.
निर्-लिंग a. having no distinguishing marks.
निर्-लेप a. 1. unsmeared, unanointed, M.v.112; 2. stainless, sinless.
निर्-लोभ a. free from desire, G.
निर्-लोमन् a. devoid of hair, hairless.
निर्-वंश a. without posterity, childless.
निर्-वण, -वन a. being out of a wood.
निर्वाण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Blown out, put out, extinguished (as a lamp), Ve.i.; 2. lost, disappeared, K.S.ii.23; 3. dead, deceased; 4. calmed, quited; 5. plunged.
निर्वाण (II) n. 1. Extinction, R.xii.1, Am.

; 2. vanishing from sight, disappearance; 3. dissolution, death; 4. eternal bliss, final emancipation from matter and reunion with the supreme spirit, R.xii.1; 5. perpetual calm; 6. complete satisfaction, highest felicity; 7. cessation; 8. union, association, confluence; 9. the bathing of an elephant, अनिर्वाणस्य दंतिनः R.i.71; 10. instruction in sciences; 11. absolute annihilation, complete extinction of worldly existence (in Buddhistic works).
निर्वाण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Blown out, put out, extinguished (as a lamp), Ve.i.; 2. lost, disappeared, K.S.ii.23; 3. dead, deceased; 4. calmed, quited; 5. plunged.
निर्-वण, -वन a. being out of a wood.
निर्-वसु a. destitute of wealth, poor.
निर्-वात (I) a. free from wind, calm, still.
निर्-वात (II) m. a place sheltered from wind.
निर्-वानर a. free from monkeys.
निर्-वायस a. free from crows.

निर्-विकल्प, -विकल्पक a. 1. not admitting an alternative; 2. being without determination; 3. recognizing no distinctions as that of subject and object or the knower and the known (as contemplation in which one loses all consciousness of difference between himself and the thing he contemplates), चेतः प्रविश सहसा निर्विकल्पे समाधौ Bhartr.iii.61, Ve.i.

निर्-विकल्प, -विकल्पक a. 1. not admitting an alternative; 2. being without determination; 3. recognizing no distinctions as that of subject and object or the knower and the known (as contemplation in which one loses all consciousness of difference between himself and the thing he contemplates), चेतः प्रविश सहसा निर्विकल्पे समाधौ Bhartr.iii.61, Ve.i.
निर्-विकार a. 1. unchanged, unchangeable, uniform; 2. disinterested, Rt.ii.28.
निर्-विकास a. unblown.
